ruleNoToday.title: Don't schedule imports to Today
ruleNoToday.description: Clear the auto-set due date on imported tasks so they don't land in Today.

ruleProjectPicker.title: Project picker on import in a project
ruleProjectPicker.description: When a task is imported while a project is open, offer a dialog to move it to another project.

providerKey.title: Issue provider key
providerKey.description: Which provider the rules apply to (e.g. JIRA, GITHUB, GITLAB, REDMINE). Leave as JIRA for Jira.

customRulesJson.title: Custom rules (advanced)
customRulesJson.description: Optional JSON array of extra rules: [{"name":"…","trigger":"taskCreated","conditions":[{"type":"titleContains","value":"bug"}],"actions":[{"type":"addTag","value":"urgent"}]}]. Conditions: isFromProvider, hasProject, titleContains, hasTag. Actions: unschedule, scheduleToday, addTag, showSnack, moveToProjectViaDialog.
